prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Odo Bogsong. Character visual motifs: stout moss-green amphibian clockmaker with hollow reed drums, pedal metronome and tiny percussion frogs.
TOP LEFT: The Beat Goes On. Ability concept: Odo displays a repeating 3-beat indicator (1.2 s/beat). Allies who begin a spell within a 0.18 s Good Beat window get 8% shorter cast recovery, once / ability / 6 s.
TOP RIGHT: Offbeat Drum. Ability concept: places a 3-beat drum pad; each beat makes a visible 40-GU ripple for light damage, never stunning automatically.
BOTTOM LEFT: Syncopation. Ability concept: moves the next pad beat earlier by 0.25 s and provides a small shield pulse to nearby allies on the adjusted beat. Enemies can see the revised countdown.
BOTTOM RIGHT: The Long Measure. Ability concept: for 4 beats, allies on Odo's rhythm gain move speed after completing casts; enemies casting exactly while a ripple touches them incur 0.4 s additional **recovery after the cast**, never a denied cast. No global heal/tenacity aura.
